instruction: I want to enable hot corners so I can quickly access the activities overview by moving my cursor to the corner. Can you enable this feature?

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires enabling hot corners. Evaluator verifies the enable-hot-corners setting is set to true using exact_match metric with vm_command_line getter.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies the instruction requirement by checking the enable-hot-corners setting
Getter logic is correct: uses gsettings command to read the GNOME desktop interface setting
Metric logic is appropriate: exact_match correctly compares the command output against expected value
Expected value is correct: 'true\n' matches the actual gsettings output format (with trailing newline)
Complete coverage: instruction asks to enable hot corners, evaluator verifies hot corners are enabled
State accessibility is good: gsettings is a persistent system setting accessible at any time, no postconfig needed
Data flow is logical: config disables setting → instruction asks to enable → evaluator checks if enabled
